items.prompt:
Climate is:
A) Today's weather
B) The average weather of a region over many years
C) A single storm
D) A kind of rock
items.answer: B) The average weather of a region over many years

steps: Climate is the long-term average of weather.

items.prompt:
Why is the equator warmer than the poles?
A) It is closer to the Moon
B) The Sun heats it more directly
C) It has more rocks
D) It rotates faster
items.answer: B) The Sun heats it more directly

steps: Sunlight hits the equator more directly.

items.prompt:
Winds and ocean currents move ___ around the planet.
A) Rocks
B) Heat and moisture
C) Fossils
D) Mountains

What two things drive global wind and ocean current patterns?
A) The Moon and tides
B) Uneven solar heating and Earth's rotation
C) Earthquakes and volcanoes
D) Only wind
items.answer: B) Uneven solar heating and Earth's rotation

steps: Uneven heating and rotation drive circulation.

items.prompt:
How can a warm ocean current affect a coastal city?
A) It cools the city sharply
B) It brings heat, giving a milder climate
C) It has no effect
D) It causes earthquakes
items.answer: B) It brings heat, giving a milder climate

steps: Warm currents carry heat to the coast, warming the climate.

items.prompt:
The main difference between weather and climate is:
A) There is none
B) Weather is short-term; climate is the long-term average
C) Climate is today only
D) Weather is over many years
items.answer: B) Weather is short-term; climate is the long-term average

steps: Climate averages weather over many years.

items.prompt:
Why can two cities at the same latitude have different climates?
A) Latitude sets everything
B) Winds and ocean currents move heat and moisture differently to each place
C) They get different sunlight amounts only
D) Climate is random
items.answer: B) Winds and ocean currents move heat and moisture differently to each place

steps: Circulation patterns deliver heat and moisture differently to each location.

items.prompt:
Uneven heating of Earth is important for climate because it:
A) Stops the wind
B) Drives the global circulation that moves heat around the planet
C) Cools the equator
D) Has no effect
items.answer: B) Drives the global circulation that moves heat around the planet

steps: Uneven heating sets up the circulation that redistributes heat.
